scripts.init: npm install && dotnet tool restore && npm run init:env
scripts.dev: npm run dev:frontend & npm run dev:backend
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.check: npm run quality:lint && npm run quality:typecheck
scripts.format: npm run quality:format:backend && npm run quality:format:frontend
scripts.sync: npm run sync:api:update && npm run sync:api:generate
scripts.quality:lint: npm run quality:lint:backend && npm run quality:lint:frontend
scripts.sync:api:generate: cd JobHuntX.API && dotnet nswag run nswag.local.json
scripts.init:env: cp JobHuntX.API/.env.sample JobHuntX.API/.env -n || true && cp client-app/.env.sample client-app/.env -n || true
